topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out that my apartment building is turning into condos. It feels like a chapter of my life is closing, and so much is up in the air now. I’ve got so many questions, and it’s a lot to take in. What does this mean for my lease? Where will I find a place like this one? The walls that have echoed with our laughter and held up our dreams are now just a part of a transaction. I’ll have to pack up more than just my belongings; I’ll be boxing up a part of my life, too. It’s a lot to think about, and the road ahead seems long and uncertain.
